about: The tractus of the formulary “Queenship of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Rejoice, O Virgin Mary: you alone have destroyed all heresies. You believed what the Archangel Gabriel said. While a virgin, you bore God and man, and after giving birth, O Virgin, you remained inviolate. Mother of God, intercede for us.

ex.w023: The adjective is a predicate of the unexpressed subject of “permansísti” (w024), the Virgin addressed: you remained inviolate.
